dialogues.speaker: Zayah
dialogues.text: Not bad, not bad, this is a great business opportunity. As they say, you have to create opportunities where they don't exist.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And you are...?

dialogues.speaker: Zayah
dialogues.text: Hmm? I'm Zayah. A proud member of the Sangemah Bay business empire.

dialogues.speaker: Zayah
dialogues.text: I'm here on the orders of our leader, Lord Sangemah Bay, to explore new business opportunities.

dialogues.speaker: Zayah
dialogues.text: And for Mora, even becoming an unscrupulous merchant is not too great a sacrifice...

dialogues.speaker: Zayah
dialogues.text: Well, uh... But of course, I shan't be breaking any of Bayda Harbor's rules! These Navbed are pretty strict on smuggling, after all...

dialogues.speaker: Zayah
dialogues.text: Surely a little business involving good Liyue food remains onboard, yes?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What business opportunity?

dialogues.speaker: Zayah
dialogues.text: Bayda Harbor is too close to Fontaine, so Fontainian goods aren't quite in vogue anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Zayah
dialogues.text: But Liyue? Now that's a different story.

dialogues.speaker: Zayah
dialogues.text: My mercantile nose is never wrong, I tell you! We just need to ship in some fine Liyue cuisine, such as...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Zayah
dialogues.text: Ah! Uninterested in business opportunities? A shame, a shame...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tea leaves?

dialogues.speaker: Zayah
dialogues.text: How did you know? A Liyue merchant named Boyan told me that Chenyu Vale's tea leaves are the most renowned in the land.

dialogues.speaker: Zayah
dialogues.text: I imagine that if we promoted Chenyu Adeptea to that big client of ours, he'd love it for sure. Bet he'd order at least 10 boxes...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Such as...

dialogues.speaker: Zayah
dialogues.text: Tiger Fish, Bamboo Shoot Soup, Crab Roe Tofu... You don't see these things in Sumeru very much, if at all.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you tried all these before?

dialogues.speaker: Zayah
dialogues.text: Oh, they're on my To-Eat list, that's for sure.

dialogues.speaker: Zayah
dialogues.text: That Boyan told me that Chenyu Adeptea was the best... and then he hoodwinked me into buying a large batch of goods that turned out to be absolute junk!

dialogues.speaker: Zayah
dialogues.text: Then he turned around and said that it was just that batch of tea that was faulty, and now that the water and soil in Chenyu Vale are back to normal, so too are the tea leaves.

dialogues.speaker: Zayah
dialogues.text: I don't trust it. Fool me once, shame on you — fool me twice, shame on me...

dialogues.speaker: Zayah
dialogues.text: I'm going to Liyue personally, and I'll taste it for myself.
